answer: Watch for shared change points. Each epoch the ledger measures every identity's style delta: how far its answers moved since last epoch. An operator who edits one system prompt or swaps the model under a farm makes every persona jump in the same week, a ripple across hundreds of accounts at once, while independent agents change on their own schedules. Accounts whose jumps coincide three times share one reward cap and one vote. Dodging that means staggering and varying each update per head, so the farm loses the cheap scale that was its zenith.
